problem: New employee cannot sign in to company email on the first day
symptoms: Login fails with invalid password or account not found; user has welcome email but no mailbox access
analysis: Mailbox was not provisioned yet or account was created without license assignment; sometimes password was reset by admin but not communicated
solution: 1. Verify user account exists in directory and is active. 2. Check mailbox/license assignment in mail admin console. 3. Reset temporary password and require change on first login. 4. Confirm username format with employee. 5. Test login in webmail and mobile app after provisioning sync.

problem: New employee cannot access VPN after onboarding
symptoms: VPN client shows authentication failed or connection timeout; user can access internet but not internal systems
analysis: VPN group membership missing, MFA not enrolled, or VPN profile not distributed to the user device
solution: 1. Check VPN account exists and is enabled. 2. Verify employee is in correct VPN access group. 3. Confirm MFA enrollment is completed. 4. Re-send VPN profile/config file. 5. Test login with a temporary support session and check VPN server logs.

problem: Laptop delivered but user cannot log in with company account
symptoms: Windows/macOS login rejects credentials; local login may work but company SSO does not
analysis: Device is not joined to domain/MDM yet, user account not assigned to device, or initial sync has not completed
solution: 1. Confirm device serial is assigned to the employee in asset/MDM system. 2. Check device is enrolled in MDM and appears online. 3. Verify domain/Entra/IdP join status. 4. Re-run enrollment or company portal setup. 5. If urgent, create temporary local admin and complete join remotely.

problem: Employee has email access but cannot access HR portal
symptoms: SSO login loops back to sign-in page or shows not authorized
analysis: HR app not assigned to user role/group; onboarding workflow created base account only
solution: 1. Verify HR portal account provisioning completed. 2. Check user is in HR-Employees group. 3. Confirm SSO app assignment and attribute mapping (email/UPN). 4. Clear browser cookies or use incognito for retest. 5. Re-sync user from identity provider if needed.

problem: Employee cannot submit timesheet in onboarding week
symptoms: Timesheet app opens but save/submit button is disabled or returns permission error
analysis: Timesheet role missing or employee start date not active in HRIS; manager relation not assigned
solution: 1. Check employee start date and employment status in HRIS. 2. Verify timesheet role/permission is assigned. 3. Confirm manager is linked to the employee record. 4. Re-sync HRIS to timesheet system. 5. Ask user to relogin and re-test submission.

problem: New hire cannot access shared onboarding documents
symptoms: SharePoint/Google Drive folder returns access denied
analysis: Folder permissions are group-based and user is not yet added to department or onboarding group
solution: 1. Identify the folder access group. 2. Add employee to onboarding/department group. 3. Wait for directory sync propagation. 4. Ask user to sign out/in. 5. Verify access with a direct file link and folder root.

problem: Corporate email works on web, but mobile phone setup fails
symptoms: Mail app cannot verify account or keeps asking for password
analysis: User is using basic IMAP setup instead of modern auth; mobile device not compliant or MFA/app password issue
solution: 1. Confirm supported mobile mail app (Outlook/Gmail/MDM-managed app). 2. Check MFA enrollment and device compliance status. 3. Use modern auth setup guide, not manual IMAP/SMTP. 4. Remove old account profile from phone and re-add. 5. Review mobile access logs if still failing.

problem: Employee cannot join onboarding Teams/Meet meeting
symptoms: Join button missing, access denied, or calendar invite not visible
analysis: Meeting invite sent before mailbox provisioning or user is not enabled for collaboration license
solution: 1. Confirm collaboration license is assigned. 2. Check mailbox/calendar provisioning completed. 3. Re-send invite to the correct company email. 4. Verify account sign-in in Teams/Meet app. 5. Test from web browser and desktop app.

problem: Account is created but user does not receive password reset email
symptoms: No welcome/reset email in inbox; user checks spam and nothing arrives
analysis: Email address typo, external mail blocked, or automated onboarding mail job failed
solution: 1. Verify personal email address used for preboarding is correct. 2. Check outbound mail queue/logs from onboarding system. 3. Re-send invitation manually. 4. Generate a temporary password and communicate securely. 5. Update onboarding workflow to validate email format before send.

problem: New employee cannot print to office printer
symptoms: Printer not visible or print job stays queued
analysis: Print server access depends on office network/VPN and printer group permissions; driver not deployed
solution: 1. Verify employee is on office network or VPN. 2. Check print group membership. 3. Deploy printer driver/profile from MDM/GPO. 4. Test print to a known shared printer. 5. Clear stuck print queue if needed.

problem: Employee cannot access finance onboarding documents
symptoms: Finance handbook or reimbursement forms show permission denied
analysis: Finance onboarding docs are restricted to finance or new-hire-finance groups; user assigned to wrong department
solution: 1. Verify department assignment in HRIS is Finance. 2. Check membership in finance onboarding group. 3. Re-run provisioning sync to document platform. 4. Confirm access using test link. 5. Correct department metadata if user was onboarded under another department.

problem: New hire cannot sign company policy acknowledgment
symptoms: E-sign platform opens but signing action is blocked or document missing
analysis: User identity in e-sign platform not provisioned or email mismatch between HRIS and e-sign account
solution: 1. Verify e-sign user exists and is active. 2. Compare HRIS email vs e-sign email exactly. 3. Re-send policy package to correct address. 4. Check if document workflow expired and restart it. 5. Confirm signing permission role is assigned.

problem: Employee onboarding checklist is incomplete although tasks were finished
symptoms: Portal still shows pending tasks after completion
analysis: Checklist integrations did not sync completion events from external systems
solution: 1. Identify which checklist steps are stuck. 2. Check integration logs for failed webhook/API calls. 3. Re-sync task statuses from connected apps. 4. Mark tasks manually if urgent. 5. Add retry logic/monitoring for onboarding sync jobs.

problem: User cannot access internal wiki on first day
symptoms: Wiki page loads but shows unauthorized or blank content
analysis: Wiki SSO group not assigned or user profile not synced from identity provider
solution: 1. Verify wiki app assignment in IdP. 2. Check employee is in all-employees or wiki-users group. 3. Re-provision user in wiki app. 4. Clear browser session and retry. 5. Review SSO assertion logs for group claims.

problem: New employee receives too many onboarding emails from multiple systems
symptoms: Duplicate welcome messages and conflicting instructions
analysis: Multiple onboarding automations are active (HRIS + manual IT process + helpdesk trigger)
solution: 1. Identify all onboarding notification sources. 2. Disable duplicate email templates/triggers. 3. Keep one authoritative onboarding sequence. 4. Update runbook to prevent manual + automatic duplication. 5. Test with a pilot user after changes.

problem: Employee was onboarded into the wrong group (IT instead of HR)
symptoms: User sees wrong apps and cannot access HR tools
analysis: Department mapping rule in onboarding automation matched wrong value or defaulted to IT
solution: 1. Check source department value in HRIS. 2. Review mapping rules in provisioning workflow. 3. Remove wrong group memberships. 4. Add correct HR group memberships and app assignments. 5. Re-run provisioning and verify app access.

problem: New hire cannot access expense reimbursement tool
symptoms: Expense tool says account inactive or no employee record found
analysis: Finance system account creation runs after HR approval and was not triggered or failed
solution: 1. Check HR approval status for the employee. 2. Review finance system provisioning job logs. 3. Manually create/sync employee in expense tool. 4. Confirm cost center and manager fields are populated. 5. Ask user to relogin and submit a test expense.

problem: Onboarding email channel creates tickets but lands in wrong Zammad group
symptoms: New hire requests arrive in Users/Helpdesk instead of HR/Onboarding/IT groups
analysis: Email channel destination group is fixed to one group; routing must be done by triggers or dedicated mailboxes
solution: 1. Confirm destination group configured on the inbound email channel. 2. Create triggers to move tickets based on sender/domain/subject patterns. 3. Optionally create separate inboxes per department. 4. Add tags for routing diagnostics. 5. Test routing with sample emails for each department.

problem: Employee cannot complete MFA setup during onboarding
symptoms: Authenticator app code rejected or enrollment page errors out
analysis: Time drift on phone, reused enrollment QR, or MFA method policy not assigned
solution: 1. Verify user is allowed by MFA policy. 2. Reset MFA enrollment and generate new QR. 3. Check phone time is set automatically. 4. Try alternate MFA method (SMS/backup code) for first login. 5. Confirm successful MFA registration in IdP logs.

problem: Onboarding request should be escalated to a human when AI cannot answer
symptoms: AI assistant returns low-confidence or generic answer and no human follow-up ticket is created
analysis: AI workflow lacks fallback rule or creates ticket without matching trigger conditions; may intentionally avoid re-trigger loop
solution: 1. Define low-confidence criteria for AI fallback. 2. Create ticket in target Zammad group (HR/IT/Finance/Onboarding) with tag ai_fallback. 3. Exclude tickets created by AI user from AI webhook trigger to avoid loops. 4. Add logging of created ticket payload and trigger matches. 5. Review trigger conditions (action/state/group/article sender) with test tickets.
